model_system: Ising spins on the pyrochlore lattice in a fragmented Coulomb spin liquid (FCSL), with monopoles on the dual diamond lattice and magnetic dipolar interactions

key_params.Hamiltonian: four-spin tetrahedral term H=J_{\square}\sum_\nu(\sum_{\langle ij\rangle\in\nu} \mathbf S_i\cdot\mathbf S_j)^2 plus dipolar interactions
key_params.dipolar_energy: E_dip=D\sum_{i>j}[\mathbf S_i\cdot\mathbf S_j-3(\mathbf S_i\cdot \hat e_{ij})(\mathbf S_j\cdot \hat e_{ij})]/(r_{ij}/r_p)^3
key_params.FCSL_constraint: all tetrahedra are single monopoles ordered in zinc-blende pattern: 3-in-1-out on one sublattice and 3-out-1-in on the other
key_params.defects: 2-in-2-out and 4-in/4-out tetrahedra as excitations out of the FCSL

headline_claim: Dipolar interactions in the FCSL produce an effective magnetic Coulomb interaction between defects with dimensionless form V/D=-(8\sqrt{2}/3\sqrt{3})(r_d/r).
replication_difficulty: medium - mainly an analytic/classical-spin derivation on pyrochlore geometry, but reproducing the FCSL defect energetics and Coulomb form requires careful lattice conventions and defect construction.
